title: Termwise flat constructible pullback-and-line models with their Tor interval
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of Noetherian schemes (schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings) [def-pc-scheme], and let $R$ be a finite commutative ring. Work on small ordinary etale sites in the constant-ring module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with exact constant-coefficient inverse image $f^{-1}=f_R^*$ [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Let $C^\bullet$ be an integer-indexed cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] of flat constructible $R_Y$-modules, zero outside an interval $[a,b]$ of integers with $a\le b$. Here flat means tensoring with the term is exact [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and constructibility is the finite locally closed constructible-stratification condition with finite constant module models on etale covers [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Let $K\in D(Y_{et},R)$ and fix an isomorphism $[C^\bullet]\simeq K$ in that derived category. Let $E$ be an $R_X$-module sheaf which is etale locally isomorphic to $R_X$, and let $r\in\mathbf Z$. Form the termwise complex
$$Q^\bullet=(f^{-1}C^\bullet\otimes_{R_X}E)[r].$$
Then $Q^\bullet$ has flat constructible terms, is zero outside $[a-r,b-r]$, is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], and the representative-defined derived comparison is an isomorphism
$$[Q^\bullet]\xrightarrow{\sim}f_R^*K\otimes^L_{R_X}E[r]$$
in $D(X_{et},R)$, with derived tensor as in [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Its cohomology sheaves are constructible, and its derived tensor with any $R_X$-module sheaf placed in degree zero has cohomology only in $[a-r,b-r]$.
More precisely, for every $j$, any stratification $(i_t:Z_t\to Y)$ witnessing constructibility of $H^{j+r}(C^\bullet)$ pulls back to the constructible locally closed strata $Z'_t=X\times_YZ_t$ (empty strata may be discarded). With $i'_t:Z'_t\to X$ and $f_t:Z'_t\to Z_t$, the restriction of $H^j(Q^\bullet)$ to $Z'_t$ is isomorphic to $f_t^{-1}i_t^{-1}H^{j+r}(C^\bullet)\otimes E|_{Z'_t}$. The pulled-back etale trivializing covers for the first factor, refined by covers trivializing $E$, exhibit finite locally constant module models on each stratum.

proof.text: Lift a geometric point through the prescribed etale cover V. The pullback/stalk and constant-sheaf/stalk isomorphisms identify the stalk of E with R, the flat tensor unit. The source geometric-fibre flatness criterion implies flatness of E. Constantness on V implies local constancy of E, and finiteness descends from the constant rank-one module on V. Thus E is finite locally constant and constructible.

proof.text: Convert finite-value constructibility to the source constructible-sheaf predicate. The proved source upperStarPreservesFlat_moduleCat instance sends every flat term of C to a flat term; it follows from the same geometric-fibre criterion. Source pullback stability and source tensor stability of constructibility give constructibility of Q^n = f^{-1}(C^{n+r}) tensor E. Tensor stability is the common-stratification argument with finite locally constant tensor factors. Exact pullback and tensor preserve zero objects, so elementary integer arithmetic gives the support interval [a-r,b-r].

proof.text: Apply the proved generic CochainComplex.kFlat_of_isStrictlyLE_of_flat (or its bounded convenience lemma) to Q and to P=f^{-1}C. For the actual representative comparison, expand the lax tensor map of Q as the strong monoidal homotopy-quotient map followed by the lax map of Qh, transported by quotientCompQhIso. The latter is tensorLeftCounit at the K-flat P and is invertible. The single-complex tensor comparison, exact pullback localization comparison, the prescribed representative e, and the shift maps are isomorphisms. Their composite is precisely etaleLineRepresentativeComparison, hence is invertible; no arbitrary comparison is selected.

proof.text: For every degree, the short complex defining homology of Q has constructible terms. Kernel closure gives constructible cycles, and cokernel closure gives constructible homology. Apply the already proved torAmplitudeIn_Q_obj_of_flat to Q supported in [a-r,b-r]; evaluating the t-structure inequalities in each outside degree gives the asserted Tor test against every degree-zero sheaf.

proof.text: The cochain homology shift isomorphism and the short-complex mapHomologyIso for exact tensor with E and exact pullback identify H^j(Q) with f^{-1}H^{j+r}(C) tensor E. Apply stratum pullback, its strong monoidal comparison, and upperStarComp on the two sides of the cartesian stratum square to obtain exactly the specified restriction formula for every j and every integer r.

proof.text: For each prescribed finite-value trivialization, use overSheafEquivFunctorObjOverIso and constantSheafSheafCongrIso to transport it to pullback along the corresponding covering morphism. On the actual cover etalePullbackLineCover take the fibre-product projections to that cover and the prescribed line cover V. The pullback equations identify the resulting compositions. Applying upperStarComp and upperStarConstantSheafIso gives constant factors M and R on each member. Monoidality of pullback and of the constant sheaf functor, followed by the right unitor M tensor R = M, gives the required finite model with precisely the given value. All constructions allow empty strata and members, the zero ring, degenerate support intervals and negative shifts.

It has 8 steps, no new nodes, and its statement, stmt_deps, source and created fields are identical to the node Q06 created (only blueprint.place was filled). There is no repair note and no SGA source. I checked Stacks 0963 (lemma-pullback-ctf): it reduces to finite flat constructible complexes and uses exact f^{-1}. The item strengthens that argument with a line E, a shift r, the representative-defined comparison and pulled-back witnesses. The Noetherian hypothesis is in the statement and is used by Step 4. Steps: 1) f^{-1} is module pullback (prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact (2)-(3)), flat pullback with no flatness of c needed, exact-functor cohomology. 2) Base change of the stratification, constructible preimages, module-linear composition, covering base change and constant pullback give the definition's conditions (a) and (b). 3) lem-pur-finite-locally-free-etale-flat is about étale sheaves (its proof uses étale stalks only), so E is flat; the single stratum X with value R witnesses constructibility. 4) All hypotheses of lem-sfb-finite-flat-constructible-total-tensor hold with [a,b] and [-r,-r]; P is K-flat, so by def-kun-derived-tensor [P]⊗^L E[r] = [T]. 5) t^Ch_{0,r} carries sign (-1)^{rp}; K-flatness is preserved by a chain isomorphism. 6) C is K-flat by kflat-criteria (1); epsilon_C gives Lf^*[C] ≅ [P], and Lf^* agrees with the exact f_R^*; the composite is the stated arrow. 7) Serre closure is used only for kernels and cokernels; the shift changes the differential by a unit. 8) The ringed-topoi pullback-tensor isomorphism along i'_t, the refinement of the two covers, and M⊗R=M give the witnesses. Index and small cases checked: r<0, a=b, R=0, X empty, R=Z/4 with non-flat N, a nonconstant line, nonreduced X. I accept all 15 declared tool_uses as generic black boxes outside the sk-lem-sp-reduction route. No duplicate found.
